We’ll see you in the hunt.

notes.title: Capcom broke Monster Hunter Rise on Steam Deck, new update fixes it
notes.content:
Update 2 - 23/01/24: Capcom has now fixed the issue that was preventing Monster Hunter Rise from launching on the Steam Deck. There is still no acknowledgment of what the original issue was or how it has been fixed so we still have no confirmation that it is tied to the implementation of Enigma DRM. Valve did update the Proton Hotfix which would allow the game to run some hours earlier, but the official fix is now live.

Update 1 22/01/24: The official Monster Hunter Rise Twitter (X) account has acknowledged the issue on Steam Deck, promising a hotfix to be released "in the very near future" but stopping short of confirming what the issue is, or if it is related to the inclusion of Enigma DRM.

Capcom has added DRM (digital rights management) to Monster Hunter Rise, effectively removing its Steam Deck verification in the process. Players are not happy and refund requests are also being rejected by Valve despite the issue.

Monster Hunter Rise still holds a verified rating on the Steam store, meaning it should be among the best Steam Deck games to play in terms of optimization. Capcom, however, has left the game unable to even launch, all because it added Enigma DRM, a controversial move that it is no stranger to.

notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #17 – Digital Event Summary!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to Kamura Hunter’s Hub #17!

We’ve just held the latest Monster Hunter Digital Event for Sunbreak, revealing all the new content coming to the game as part of Free Title Update 4 on February 7th, so we thought we’d share a quick summary with you in case you missed it!

Yep, not long to wait until you clash with a familiar foe, born from ice…

[previewyoutube=6MaZ0V0QNF0;full][/previewyoutube]

Now that’s a [i]cool[/i] update! If you’d like to watch the Digital Event in full, we’ll have that embedded at the bottom of the post for your viewing pleasure.


[H1]Ice to see you again, Velkhana![/h1]

Behold the Lord of the Tundra, Velkhana! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/d101a4bfe6bf8148f457505068487bbe3f33a886.jpg[/img]

You can expect a frigid reception when facing this returning Elder Dragon. Able to manipulate water particles in the air around it to snap freeze its prey, as well as manifesting lethal pillars and shards of ice to shatter their opponent’s body and will. Get ready Hunters, you’re in Velkhana’s turf now!

We know that some of you brave Hunters who spent time in the New World and Hoarfrost Reach will find this hunt familiar, but just as you’ve learnt some new tricks, so has Velkhana…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/eb960dde3522dd03460fbb972562bfd83271f445.jpg[/img]

You’ll be able to enter Velkhana’s frozen domain from MR 10, so wrap up warm Hunters! 

[b]Ice-cold Gear![/b]

The arrival of Velkhana also means new armour and weapons for you and your buddies! What powers they’ll imbue, we’ll leave you to discover…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/cc5a65d2d0398731ed4ca416af43d9176c1a5515.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/03050f69074e2a9ef7a3911b097f4e5bf5d7bbb6.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Fallen Star Rises…[/h1]

Another Elder Dragon has overcome the affliction, bare witness the meteoric rise of Risen Crimson Glow Valstrax! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/ffd9f74b39d02918f18f8b953400c705b058b7c0.jpg[/img]

Bringing with it one of the toughest challenges in Sunbreak to date, Risen Crimson Glow Valstrax will give you an unrelenting hunt, giving you no respite at close- and long-range combat.

Just like with our other Risen Elder Dragons, you can expect new, never-before-seen moves. You’ll discover why some call it the Comet of Doom…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/55bd2834dad5960a3aff5e80de265c3ea831f762.jpg[/img]

You’ll be able to take on Risen Crimson Glow Valstrax in its realm of despair from MR 160! Watch the skies…

[b]Give your Hunter a meteoric glow![/b]

Those that manage to overcome this new Risen threat will be able to craft a new set for their Hunter! What power awaits at the comet’s core? You’ll find out soon…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/9c015c0617a01540fe74d8cee5e861e6af28a760.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Anomaly Investigation Deepens…[/h1]

As you’ve seen in previous Free Title Updates, the maximum level of Sunbreak’s endgame, Anomaly Investigations, has increased again, reaching a new cap of 220!

With the new cap comes A8★ Anomaly Research quests and a spicy new twist to the existing formula. Alongside Afflicted Chaotic Gore Magala, Risen Elder Dragons will also start appearing in Anomaly Investigations at Level 111 and above.

Yep, you read that right, Risen Elders such as Risen Kushala, Risen Teostra and Risen Chameleos will be making your acquaintance outside of their existing quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/f668017ea35496c84f9ff48a6cbd5fb7a8f60e81.jpg[/img]

The original Risen Elders are tough, and these Anomaly Investigation versions, well let’s just say they’re definitely rising to the challenge…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/d2b8a9791fdfb050ec39dd020b7828fb00b969b1.jpg[/img]

[b]New Challenges, New Rewards[/b]

Taking down these empowered Risen Elders will yield new crafting materials that’ll allow you to unlock the level cap for Qurious Crafting on your weapons, giving you the option to further empower your weapons by increasing the number of Anomaly Slots at your disposal!

Bahari’s also increased his stock at the Anomaly Research Lab, so you’ll have even more goodies and monster parts to spent those Investigation Coins on!

We’ve also got some new quality of life additions coming to the Anomaly Research system. Previously, you needed to hunt the specified monster in order to make progress towards the Investigation Coin bonus. Now, all Afflicted monsters above the states level will count towards the request counter, but if you hunt the requested monster, you’ll receive a juicy bonus. Also, the conditions will be adjusted to more regularly draw a lower quest level floor for the request.

Bahari’s got your back!


[h1]Eventful Event Quests![/h1]

You’ll be pleased to hear that we’ve got another big batch of Event Quests for you that’ll start to roll out weekly from Free Title Update 4!

If you like to put your skills to the test, you’re in for a treat as Dual Threat quests make a return and this time they’ve brought with them a Seething Bazelguese x Chaotic Gore Magala combo, as well as Furious Rajang and Scorned Magnamalo! (Just who’s angrier out of these 2? We guess you’ll find out soon)

But hey, we know that when it comes to Event Quests you’re keen to know what’s up for grabs…

The team have some exciting rewards for you to earn, with multiple sets of layered armour and individual layered gear pieces. Check out just a few of them below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/b7a1898bf4ee62ddfc4075b3b91b562d3f611efe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/50bd8b385a87a278118bdaab60a7ff83e07c60e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/d32c0b376e44573c4294bdad08a04d6673c299fc.jpg[/img]

These rewards, as well as the others we haven’t shown, will be made available throughout Free Title Update 4!


[h1]Get a free Palamute Costume![/h1]

To celebrate Velkhana’s arrival in Sunbreak, we’re giving you the opportunity to get early access to a free Palamute Costume that’ll show off your faithful buddy’s chill composure, literally…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/9a560fcb478f0b2aa3873b00eea3ae8d5755bc9c.jpg[/img]

Oh yes! Your Palamute can rock the Velkhana look both at the hub and in the hunt! Big win for the Hunters among us who’ve always wanted a pet Elder Dragon!

[b]How to claim your free costume[/b]

In order to get this Costume, all you need to do is create a Capcom UD account and enter the giveaway before February 5 at 8pm PST / February 6th at 4am GMT / 5am CET.

The Capcom ID is our unified account that includes services for a variety of Capcom games. Creating an account is free. The Velkhana Costume will also be available to other players at a later date.

Head to the official website [url=https://cid.capcom.com/en/]HERE[/url] for more details and to sign-up! 


[h1]A Few “Animated” Friends…[/h1]

Alongside all the free content that’s we’ve added in Free Title Update 4, we’ve also added some additional, optional paid DLC including layered armour, gestures, poses, BGM, and more fun optional content to spice up your hunting life.

But we wanted to give a special spotlight to one particular drop… behold the stars of [url=https://www.monsterhunter.com/rise/us/hunting-guide/]Minoto’s Hunting Guide[/url], Lance Gunn, Ran Page, Pup R. and Kit T.!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/13f87c78efbe6799390c6751c2980c33a6dfcd23.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/ac4f692690cb083dc563458f97783ff4d0a322a4.jpg[/img]
[i]Do these look like the faces of mercy to you!?[/i]

These layered costumes will be available to buy after Free Title Update 4 is live! You'll find them in our DLC section on the store page, so feel free to check them out!  

[H1]The Hunt Continues![/h1]

That wraps up our summary of Free Title Update 4 ahead of its arrival on February 7! What are you most excited for? Let us know in the comments!

Oh and the hunt doesn’t end with this update, Free Title Update 5 arrives in April and brings with it a truly fearsome returning Elder Dragon. Prepare yourselves, Hunters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/c22a411f1fd4fcee053fa42802be19c5008dcee8.png[/img]


[h1] Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up today’s summary post! Thanks for taking the time to check it out! 

As mentioned at the start of the post, if you’d like to watch the Digital Event in full, you can do so below: 

[previewyoutube=sZPXaICnKIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re off to prepare for the incoming quality of life feature, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/5132448321915102649]Hunter Loadouts[/url]! (Got to prep those layered sets for our different elemental weapons, you know how it is!)

See you in the hunt!

- Monster Hunter Community Team

We’ve got a Sunbreak Developer double-bill for you as we share some challenging hunt gameplay straight from the team, as voted for by the community on Twitter, and put a spotlight on the Dev Teams very own buddies that they take out on hunts – including those of both Rise and Sunbreak’s Directors!

Let’s jump in!

[h1]The Sunbreak Developer’s Challenge[/h1]

Since mid-October, the Sunbreak Dev Team have been putting their skills on display in the Sunbreak Developer’s Challenge, taking on Event Quests as they showcase their moves against a range of Sunbreak’s monsters! 

Each Developer that takes part has also been sharing a “Challenger’s Comment” with some fun insight at the end of their clip – we’ll share those under the videos too!

The first one dropped on October 14th, with subsequent ones being voted for by the community on Twitter! Let’s take a look at what hunts have gone down so far…

[b]Hunt 1 – Dual Blades[/b]

Things kicked off in style as one of Sunbreak’s Game Designers took on the Event Quest “Dual Threat: Go Out with a Bang!”, tasking them with taking down not one, but two Seething Bazelgeuse with their dual blades! 

[previewyoutube=4VOJBveArLE;full][/previewyoutube]

It turns out our Game Designer was quite the fan of Spiral Slash, and they took a moment to explain why:

[i]“I’m a game designer on Sunbreak. I mostly focused on using the Spiral Slash this time.

The MHGU team had a hunter art naming content, and “Rasenzan” (Spiral Slice) was actually my idea!

I hope you all give it a spin.”[/i]

Following that we held a weapon poll for the next video between Long Sword, Gunlance, Charge Blade and Bow, with the winner being…

[b]Hunt 2 – Gunlance![/b]

That’s right, Gunlance’s explosive personality blasted it to victory in the community poll!

Another brave Sunbreak Game Designer stepped forward, Gunlance in hand and took on the Event Quest “Dual Threat: A Returning Rush of Red”, pitting them against the fearsome Elder Dragons, Malzeno and Shagaru Magala…

[previewyoutube=pyyE3kiwcFk;full][/previewyoutube]

We saw many comments from Gunlancers that our Developer had an unexpected, yet effective playstyle, encouraging them to try it out for themselves! What could have led to this playstyle? Well, it turns out this particular Game Designer worked very closely with the Gunlance on Sunbreak:

[i]“I’m a game designer on Sunbreak. I used different Switch Skill Swap Scrolls for each monster.

I designed the Reverse Blast to offer both good offense and defense.

It’s quite a lot of fun to blast around with the Gunlance, so I hope you give it a try!”[/i]

Then came the next poll, pitting Sword & Shield, Hammer, Insect Glaive and Light Bowgun against each other, with the winner being…

[b]Hunt 3 – Insect Glaive![/b]

The Insect Glaive gracefully vaulted itself into our third and most recent challenge video!

Our third intrepid Sunbreak Game Designer stepped into the arena (literally) against a Crimson Glow Valstrax and Furious Rajang in the Event Quest “Dual Threat: Destructive Stars”!

[previewyoutube=ocsrfyM_6eM;full][/previewyoutube]

Our Developer used a range of aerial and ground combos to successfully complete the hunt, and even took a moment to share their personal tips for Kinsects:

[i]“I’m a game designer on Sunbreak.

I tried out the Speed Type Kinsect “Fleetflammer” this time. The Speed Type Kinsect Charge kind of keeps your hands busy, but I feel that gives it a stronger sense of joint combat than the Assist Type.

The Kinsect Type greatly changes how the insect glaive plays, so I recommend trying out types you haven’t used before!”[/i]

What’s next for the Sunbreak Developer’s Challenge? Well, our latest Twitter poll recently with the Hunting Horn being selected as the winner!

That means that the next video will be releasing in the near future over on the official [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]Monster Hunter Twitter[/url], so feel free to drop us a quick follow if you’d like to see another member of the Sunbreak team showcasing their skills in the hunt!


[h1]Buddy Spotlight – Meet the team’s Buddies![/h1]

Now you’ve seen some of the team in action! But what about our faithful Palico and Palamute pals? If you’re keen to see what Buddies some of the team use, or after some cheeky Buddy build inspiration, we’ve got you covered!

We’re currently mid-way through our Buddy Spotlight on Twitter, so we figured it’s about time we looped you in on it too! 

So, get ready to meet the Buddies of Monster Hunter Rise Director, Yasunori Ichinose, Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak Director, Yoshitake Suzuki, as well as Sunbreak’s Lead Buddy Designer! 

[b]Director Ichinose’s Buddies![/b]

First up, meet the buddies of Monster Hunter Rise Director, Yasunori Ichinose! The fluffy black and purple look of the buddies matches the violet princess look of the Hunter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/a41c319d88b9ab1c1d96537183f84ba441bde7da.jpg[/img]

Check out the details of their hunting set [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter/status/1589634531656859649?s=20&t=jdrb2_LAItuScVd9X1WMYg]HERE[/url].


[b]Director Suzuki’s Buddies![/b]

Director Suzuki uses two sets of buddies, with one consisting of two Palicos. He focuses first and foremost on having the most noble look possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/0fd98164b8adeaa1cf983f74e9635f580cb1ae10.jpg[/img]

Naturally, these buddies are as sharp as their fashion when it comes to the hunt, so check out their set [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter/status/1594740225082884096?s=20&t=GkyPJL8N7GXqHiLUWttx8g]HERE[/url].


[b]Lead Buddy Designer’s Buddies![/b]

Now we have the Lead Buddy Designer’s very own Buddies! Let’s check out what they had to say when we asked about their Buddies:

[i]“I chose a cute and dark layered armor. My buddies are a combination of my versatile Palamute, covering both attack and healing, and my Palico who is skilled at chance-making.”[/i]

(A pawfect combo in our opinion!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/f4e534b03e834da3aee898e049f67d36c058cfc8.jpg[/img]

How does our Lead Buddy Designer kit out their buddies with gear and skills for the hunt? Find out [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter/status/1599796036930879490?s=20&t=l3xTJErhOXZYfPEJhqqXuw]HERE[/url].


That wraps up our current Buddy Spotlights! We’ll be sharing more on the official [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]Monster Hunter Twitter[/url] account soon!

Did anything catch your gaze? Will you be teaching your Buddies some new tricks, or maybe even upgrading their wardrobe? Let us know!

Oh, and one more thing, whilst we’re chatting about it, if you want some cool new layered gear for your furry friends, make sure to complete our recently added Event Quest “Purr-ivate Eye”! 

Doing so will unlock these rather dapper outfits for budding detectives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/349997968262ba257751d30ca79f5f496f440a19.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks for checking it out!

We hope you enjoyed seeing the Dev Team in action in the Sunbreak Developer’s Challenge, as well as getting a little look at how some of the team like to equip their Buddies for the hunt! 

We’ll be back again soon with another community update, but in the meantime happy hunting with Free Title Update 3!

See you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: The Path to Sunbreak - New Player Info: Part 2!
notes.content:
[h1]Defender Weapons & Black Belt S Gear[/h1]

Hello Hunters and welcome to Part 2 of our “Path to Sunbreak” Community Post!

This part is spoiler free, so fear not if you’re looking discover the story of Rise on your own terms! 

Now, in this part we’re going to be looking at some optional free gear that’s available to assist you as you settle into Rise, should you wish to use it, kitting out your Palico and Palamute Buddies for the hunt, as well as some handy tips for capturing monsters!

Let’s get stuck in!

[b]Introducing Defender Weapons and Black Belt S Gear![/b]

[previewyoutube=FZKCnM6Isqs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Suit-up with Black Belt S Gear[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/1a89093ff4b5b0c449466ca64d3b4b6a8fa8cda2.png[/img]

The Black Belt S gear is a set of armour that any player can pick-up from the friendly Felyne, Senri the Mailman, in Kamura.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/afe0810174830ce4c0ef52afaac73cd665675bff.jpg[/img]

Simply start a conversation with him, select “Add-on content” and then “Accept All”, or seek out the armour in the list of available content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/9c410c2f0ac1bc9f4761dc950e79e464b6843151.png[/img]

Once done, head over to your item box and you’ll be able to equip this powerful set! Built for use in both Low and High Rank quests, this set boasts 330 defence and comes with a range of offensive armour skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/854a7689acba32c02396e1b2cc3d02d16f5e8af4.png[/img]

The Black Belt S gear’s individual pieces can be mixed with other sets, so if you’re looking to make a set with specific skills, feel free to experiment as you hunt more monsters and unlock the ability to craft their armour.

(And yes, fashion hunters, this is also available as Layered Armour!)

[b]Grab those Defender Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/deb6107ee257d97344dcb32d53135efc791f03b7.png[/img]

Just like the Black Belt S gear, you’ll also be able to get the Defender Weapons in one bundle from Senri the Mailman! 

The Defender Weapons cover all 14 weapon types, so whether you’re a Hammer smasher, Long Sword wielder or nimble Bowgunner, you won’t miss out! These weapons begin stronger that the equivalent starting weapons and can also be upgraded as you progress through the game, further increasing their strength! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/88c637cc43f70b31f53f17b22545ff46c99afbc0.jpg[/img]

The Defender weapons not only serve as a great way to start your quest to save Kamura, but also introduce you to the deep and rewarding gear crafting and upgrade system! 

Of course, whilst useful, these weapons are entirely optional, so check them out if you like, or feel free to explore the huge range of weapons you can craft as you progress through the game. From weapons that cause elemental damage and status effects to those focused on raw attack output, there’s plenty of choice to suit your preferred playstyle and capitalise on monster weaknesses!


[h1]Some Extra Tips![/h1]

[b]Helpful buddies (Support)[/b]

Don’t overlook the importance of your buddies during a hunt! If you’re playing solo, you can bring up to two buddies with you. Mix and match a Palico and Palamute, or even run with two of the same type of buddy. Remember that in a multiplayer hunt, you can only bring one buddy, so make sure you have your preferred buddy in your primary spot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/f0f46e7025a77aeff977cda9d0424b6dc6f0f26e.png[/img]

Buddy Skills are another key component that will aid you in progressing through the low and high ranks faster. Regardless of which type of buddy you bring; the Knockout King skill is a great choice that will increase the likelihood of stunning and tiring monsters. If you’re looking for a bit of protection from your Palamute, the Guarding Parasol is a nice aid to protect yourself from a few hits.

  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/f144e1dbd136299eedda41b35586ea325aed95e1.jpg[/img]

For Palicoes, you have quite a bit of flexibility on what type of buddy to bring with you. On the community team, we’re big fans of Gathering Palicoes thanks to their Endemic Life Barrage and Pilfer skills! Although the results can be somewhat unpredictable depending on what toad is used (Sleep, Paralysis etc), Endemic Life Barrage’s status ailments are helpful in a pinch when taking on tough monsters. Lastly, this support type does what it says…gather more materials, whether that’s items found around the locale, or extra monster parts using the Pilfer skill! And as we know, more loot is never a bad thing!

These are just a few suggestions to get you started, but as with all tips in this guide, feel free to play around with what works best for your preferred playstyle! The Buddy system is flexible and versatile to suit how you want to play, but hopefully these tips give you a good place to start from!


[b]How to capture monsters[/b]

Capturing a Monster can oftentimes be a quick and sure-fire way to wrap up a quest quickly and get you moving up the ranks quicker! Although you’ll be able to tell a Monster is ready to be captured based on its more sluggish behaviour, the two best ways to tell when it’s time to bring the traps out are when your Palico Buddy mentions the Monster is ready for capture, or when the blue skull-like icon appears below the Monster’s icon in the top right corner. 

To capture a Monster, you’ll need to snare them in either a Shock Trap or Pitfall Trap. We recommend always having one of each in your item loadout, just to be sure! Once the Monster is caught in the trap, throw down two Tranq Bombs right next to it to complete the capture. 

Keep in mind that some Monster materials can only be obtained by slaying the Monster, and others have different drop rates depending on how you defeat the Monster. If you’re playing in a group, it helps to be on the same page on whether to slay or capture the Monster!


[h1]Wrapping Up![/h1]

That about does it for our tips, so it’s time for us to set you loose on those Monsters with all the knowledge above. Whether you follow this advice down to the letter or decide to forge your own path to Master Rank, remember to have fun and treat every hunt as a fun learning experience! Before you know it, you’ll be in Elgado and taking on some of those tough challenges in the Citadel. 

Good luck Hunters, you’ve got this!

See you in the hunt!

- Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: The Path to Sunbreak - New Player Info: Part 1!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to the “Path to Sunbreak” Community Post Part 1!

If you’re brand new to Monster Hunter Rise, or have picked it up recently and are still exploring what Kamura Village has to offer, let us give you a monster-sized [b]WELCOME[/b] to the community!

Whether you’re looking to fully explore the engaging story and dozens of hours of gameplay Monster Hunter Rise has to offer, or prefer to reach the massive Sunbreak expansion as efficiently as possible, this post is for you!

Of course, there is no “correct" way to play, and all this information is purely optional, so we encourage new players to feel free to progress through Monster Hunter Rise however you would like. As long as you’re having fun, that’s what matters! 


[h1][b]The Path to Sunbreak[/b][/h1]

[b]SPOILER WARNING – This section contains potential story and monster spoilers for Monster Hunter Rise. If you’d like to avoid these, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1446780/view/3631619851533217991]click here to skip to Part 2 “Defender Weapons & Black Belt S Gear”[/url] – which is spoiler free and covers some cool free gear for your Hunter! [HYPERLINK]
This section is for those of you who are looking for a direct route to unlocking the Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak expansion content![/b]

In order to get started on Sunbreak’s content, in addition to owning the expansion, you will need to have completed the 7-star Urgent Hub Quest [b]Serpent Goddess of Thunder[/b] that can be found in the latter stages of Rise’s story. You can then talk to Dame Rondine to start your Sunbreak adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/54aecc49ad17e4b3653ca150843c565357c9c938.jpg[/img]

Don’t worry about missing any Rise content; starting Sunbreak won’t lock you out of Rise, so you can also choose to continue with Rise’s story and endgame content or play both. 


[h1]Village vs Hub[/h1]

Now you know the destination, let’s look at the two starting points: Village Quests and Hub Quests! Your ultimate goal lies in the Hub quests, so it’s a question of whether you take it from the Hub directly or start with the Village quests instead. Let’s explore each option in detail.

[b]Village Quests [Single player only][/b]

If you’re a new player looking to immerse yourself in Rise’s story while easing yourself into combat and crafting, this route is for you!

Quests are grouped into numbered star levels of increasing difficulty and complexity. Starting at 1-star, you’ll need to complete Key Quests to unlock an Urgent Quest, the completion of which unlocks the next star level! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/ccb3073e38eb91b1f6451aec10cdf889026d1aad.jpg[/img]

Once you’ve completed the 6-star Village Quests, you’ll be almost ready to move onto Hub quests and High Rank! Hub quests work in a similar fashion, but introduce the concept of Hunter Rank, beginning with Low Rank quests at Hunter Rank 1 and moving up the ranks as you complete Key and Urgent quests.

However, here’s a tip for getting through the Hub quests more quickly: speak to Hinoa in Kamura village after you complete the 4-Star Village quests and she will offer three [b]Special Licence Test[/b] quests. Completing all three of these challenges will allow you to jump straight into 4-star Hub quests, bypassing the first three star levels!

[h1]Hub Quests [Single & multiplayer][/h1]

If you’re looking to dive straight into multiplayer and play through Rise with your friends, and are happy to skip the Village side of things, this route’s for you! You’ll know from the “Path to Sunbreak” section that your goal is to complete the 7-star Urgent Quest [b]Serpent Goddess of Thunder[/b], but unlike the Village, in the Hub you’ll be heading on group hunts with other players. (Don’t worry if your party size fluctuates, or if you play solo: all Hub Quests scale based on party size to create a bespoke and fun experience, no matter how many hunters join.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/c09fcae162830275b46faf901e9dd54ce1d9cdd7.jpg[/img]

As with Village Quests, you’ll need to complete a selection of Key Quests at each star level, before then completing an Urgent Quest and progressing to the next Hunter Rank. If you’re playing with friends and someone has unlocked the quest, everyone gets credit for the quest completion! Teamwork makes the dream work! 

In Hub Quests, Hunter Ranks 1-3 are classed as Low Rank, with 4+ falling into the more challenging High Rank category – but with greater challenge comes greater reward! 

Reach and complete Serpent Goddess of Thunder, and – congratulations! – you’ll be ready to start the Sunbreak expansion adventure and head to Elgado!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/7557e1c57213bc5090adec4c439da7b175c8f860.jpg[/img]

However, if you’re looking to discover the true ending to Rise’s story, you might want to stick around in the Hub a little longer…


[h1]Part 1 Complete![/h1]

That wraps up Part 1 of our “Path to Sunbreak” Community Post, including any spoilery bits!
But wait, before you dive back into the hunt, there’s more! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1446780/view/3631619851533217991]CLICK HERE[/url] to head over to Part 2, which includes some information on powerful gear you can pick-up for free, equipping your Palicoes and Palamutes, as well as some handy pointers for capturing monsters – speeding up your hunts!

See you over there!

- Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: A Message From Director Suzuki – Gunlance Shelling Level Boosts!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

We hope the week’s been treating you well!

Following on from last week’s Director Suzuki Post, in which he gave us our first look at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3380540365808725059]the new Anomaly Investigation level adjustment feature[/url] coming to Sunbreak as part of Free Title Update 3, we’re back with his latest info drop… and this one’s for the Gunlancers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/bd32c67642fbe9641499082d667b28ea230709ef.jpg[/img]

- Suzuki, Sunbreak Director[/i]

We’re excited to see an increased range of Gunlances blasting through Sunbreak’s endgame! Which Gunlances will you be upgrading first and taking into the hunt? Let us know in the comments!

For those wondering, Free Title Update 3 will be available to all Sunbreak players in late November, with even more Free Title Updates coming in 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/0fa1d931856bfb6b3f25f00706812b08f400d7be.jpg[/img]

Thanks everyone! See you in the hunt!

notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #15 – Title Update 2’s New Armour Skills Overview!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to Kamura Hunter’s Hub #15!

In this week’s post we’re going to be taking a closer look at the new armour skills that arrived as part of Free Title Update 2! These skills are unique to the three new armour sets that can be crafted from defeating Title Update 2’s new monsters and offer interesting new ways to power-up your playstyle, so we thought we’d check them out with you! 

Director Suzuki also has a message to share about a powerful feature that you can harness by using Flaming Espinas weapons…

Before we get into that though, we’d like to say a HUGE welcome to all the new Hunters who joined us in the recent sale. Whether you’re stepping into Kamura for the first time, or taking a voyage over to Elgado Outpost with Fiorayne, we hope you’re having an awesome time – thank you for joining us.

Oh and for those new Hunters, if you’re looking for a helping hand, or simply want to get to Sunbreak as quickly as possible, check out our free, optional Black Belt S armour and Defender Weapon set:

[previewyoutube=FZKCnM6Isqs;full][/previewyoutube]

Right then, it’s time to chat about that spicy new gear!


[h1]New Monsters, New Armour Skills![/h1]

Three fearsome new monsters arrived with TU2 in the forms of Flaming Espinas, Violet Mizutsune and Risen Chameleos! 

They’ve brought the heat, and Hunters that rise to the challenge will reap the rewards! With hot new weapons in the case of Flaming Espinas and Violet Mizutsune, plus new armour sets, skills and decorations for all three monsters, you’re going to be keeping Minayle busy!

[b]Flaming Espinas & Intrepid Heart – MR 10[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/22b83db945867eae409e3f778e32a3c9f061bc0f.jpg[/img]

Flaming Espinas by name, Flaming Espinas by nature! Hunters that manage to take down this fiery monster will be able to start crafting its set of weapons and armour, channelling this monster’s unrelenting nature.

As with all other armour sets, there’s a range of skills available for you to utilise, but today we’ll be highlighting its unique new skill, “Intrepid Heart”, which can be found on Flaming Espinas’s Arms and Greaves.

Intrepid Heart is a skill with two levels that does the following:

[i]After filling the gauge by continuously landing attacks, negates damage reactions and reduces damage taken from a single attack that would knock you back.[/i]

At level one you’ll get the above effect, and with two levels you’ll reduce damage further and also release a damaging explosion when struck! 

If you’re looking for a rocksteady offence, this one’s for you! After all, they do say the best form of defence is attack…


[b]Violet Mizutsune & Embolden – MR 10[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/142383f4539575d83cd45cac4457e4640c106b94.jpg[/img]

Sliding in with a barrage of bubbles, Violet Mizutsune is ready to put a singe in the step of any Hunter who dare challenges it! 

After hunting this monster the crafting can begin as you embrace being the centre of attention for powerful buffs! 

That’s right, Violet Mizutsune’s set comes with the unique skill “Embolden”, which can be found on its chest, greaves and waist! 

Embolden is a skill with three levels that does the following:

[i]When targeted by a monster, that monster becomes more likely to become enraged but your own defence is increased.

Level 1: While active, defence +10, slightly prolongs dodging invincibility and slightly lowers impact when guarding.

Level 2: While active, defence +20, prolongs invincibility when dodging and lowers impact when guarding.

Level 3: While active, defence +40, greatly prolongs dodging invincibility and greatly lowers impact when guarding.[/i]

For Hunters that relish being in the spotlight, this ones for you! And about the monsters you face being enraged more? These pieces also come with Agitator to really capitalise on the situation! 

If you’re looking for a powerful defensive and offensive boost when it matters the most, check out the Embolden skill and the Violet Mizutsune armour pieces it comes on!


[b]Risen Chameleos & Buildup Boost – MR 110[/b]

Rising up to overcome the affliction, Risen Chameleos unleashes a toxic nightmare to any foolish, or brave enough to confront it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/d4e34aef67886280428159453e961f4073571dd1.jpg[/img]

This one’s for the Hunters who, much like Risen Chameleos, head into the hunt with hard hitting offensive status attacks at the forefront of their strategy! 

Equipping the Greaves, Chest or Arms of Risen Chameleos’s set will grant you the new skill “Buildup Boost”!

Buildup Boost is a skill with three levels that does the following: 

[i]Increases attack power when you land attacks that build poison, paralysis, sleep, blast, or exhaust. (Exhaust - ammo/phials/coatings only)

Level 1: While active, increases attack power by 10%

Level 2: While active, increases attack power by 15%.

Level 3: While active, increases attack power by 20%.[/i]

Oh yes, landing blows that build status effect will increase your attack power for that strike! We’ve enjoyed seeing the build crafting occurring within the community as they’ve sought to harness the true potential of this skill.

From what we’ve seen so far, it looks like a certain “Status Trigger” skill from Title Update 1’s Gold Rathian armour has some powerful synergy with Buildup Boost, so it might be worth getting hunting party together for a visit to the Illustrious Queen…

But remember Hunters, this is just one of many combinations! Have you been utilising Buildup Boost, or any of the other new skills that arrived in Title Update 2? Let us know how in the comments, we love reading about your favourite and ingenious new skill combos and sets.


[h1]A Message From Sunbreak Director Suzuki[/h1]

[i]Hey everyone! 

Free Title Update 2 is now available. Weapons made from Flaming Espinas materials possess two different elements. Only the main element is displayed on the weapon's details screen, but the weapons also possess a poison element that builds up as you attack a monster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/96caac251839091d93fc3f978404251de7208c3f.jpg[/img]

We've also identified an issue where using gestures/poses in quick succession can put a heavy tax on the Lobby. We've restricted this in Ver.12, but we'll continue to look into ways of allowing as many inputs as possible whilst maintaining the stability of the game.

- Suzuki, Sunbreak Director[/i]


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks for coming by and checking it out!
We hope you’re all having a great time with Free Title Update 2’s content, from the new monsters, armour and weapons, to the new Decorations, Qurious Crafting upgrades and Anomaly Investigation level cap increase! 

For those of you yet to reach MR10, fear not, after completing Sunbreak’s story you’ll be just a few hunts away from joining in on the expanding Sunbreak endgame too!

We’ll be back again soon with another community update, but in the meantime, happy hunting! 

See you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: Kamura Hunter's Hub #14 - Event Quest Recap & Tokyo Game Show Approaches!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, 

Welcome to Kamura Hunter’s Hub #14!

A lot has happened since our last post, with the arrival of Title Update 1 and its expansive endgame content additions you’ve certainly been busy hunting!

From new monsters to Anomaly Investigations and Qurious Crafting, we hope you’ve been having a ton of fun taking on the new challenges and reaping the rewards to further upgrade your gear!

It’s been really cool seeing how the new armours introduced in Title Update 1 have been weaved into your existing sets too, those new armour skills seem to be going down well – we see you Status Trigger enjoyers! (to name just one!)

On that note of new content, let’s take a little look back at the first month of Event Quests and a look forward at what’s coming to Sunbreak in the near future… 


[h1]An Eventful Month![/h1]

At the timing of this post, the first four weekly Sunbreak Event Quests are live and ready for you to take on! Just swing by Senri the Mailman in Kamura Village, or the Courier in Elgado Outpost to unlock these free quests!

Event Quests offer something a little different to existing quests, with new challenges and monster combinations, as well as sweet new rewards that include new poses, gestures and layered armour!

Let’s take a look at what’s available for you to play and unlock right now: 

[b]Event Quest 1 – “A Grand Gesture” - MR 1[/b]

We kicked things off after Title Update 1’s arrival with “A Grand Gesture”, tasking you to take down a Blood Orange Bishaten and Aknosom to unlock the “It’s Over!” gestures. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/4edf529b65085e3798ab2678094c078d4899ea32.jpg[/img]


[b]Event Quest 2 – “Dual Threat: Revelry of Destruction” – MR 10[/b]

Things got furious in the second Event Quest as we introduced a new quest format, Dual Threat! 

And what better way to ease you in than to throw you into an arena with two Furious Rajang who are very [i]pleased[/i] to see you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/cbf1d3f20370ac68583792c0c92851f12f5b5893.jpg[/img]

Hunters who best these beasts earn the right to wear the Qurio Crown, a new layered armour exclusive to this quest! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/2d3ef953bdabcb99f9cfc8cfedca4badc1261a96.jpg[/img]
(Yes, you can change the colour of the whole crown to whatever your fashion desires!) 


[b]Event Quest 3 – “Flash of Inspiration” – MR 1[/b] 

There was electric in the air for the third Event Quest, with Hunters facing off against an Astalos for the right to rock some Frontier fashion with the Lien layered armour set!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/148fd608fb603cbd403f4a9f547d014c690e28cb.jpg[/img]
Wear the full set, or mix and match as you please! 


[b]Event Quest 4 – “Minor Inconveniences” – MR 1[/b]

The latest Event Quest presents you with some “Minor Inconveniences” in the form of Garangolm and Aurora Somnacanth, who stand between you and the Delightful Post Set!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/dde9d5befc8e66c36f55fc106855cbdf91f8d536.jpg[/img]
Talk about a frosty reception!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/a7192e8ada86da433f260ed5de33ce9e106ee9cb.jpg[/img]
The Delightful Pose Set, guaranteed to put a smile on your face! 


[b]Event Quests – More on the way![/b]

We hope you’ve been enjoying what the first batch of Event Quests have offered you! Naturally, this is just the start and there’s plenty more on the way each week, so make sure to say hi to Senri and the Courier on a regular basis.


[h1]Sunbreak comes to Tokyo Game Show![/h1]

Join us on Thursday, September 15th at 23:00 JST / 15:00 BST / 16:00 CEST / 07:00 PDT for the TGS2022 Capcom Online Program!

Don’t miss out as Sunbreak will be part of the program and include exciting new information on Title Update 2, so stay tuned to be among the first to find out what awaits you in late September… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/c8bea784c8aa322e0d5f9700b88c0e2507de73e6.jpg[/img]

We’ll be broadcasting the event live across our social media channels, including the official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/monsterhunter]Monster Hunter Twitch Account[/url]. 


[h1]Sunbreak Director Suzuki Update[/h1]

Talking of Title Update 2, Director Suzuki stopped by recently with a sneak peek at some more quality-of-life additions coming as part of the update…

[i]Hey everyone! Starting this week, we will be sharing details regarding the content of the upcoming Free Title Update 2. As part of this update, the number of shortcut loadouts will be increased to eight.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/e08d76c8b99d3f9816297fb3d8596bbd7c09becd.jpg[/img]

[i]Also, you will be able to lock your armour, thereby preventing it from accidentally being sold or used in crafting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/879a92bce66401b58a74446391b16461e66b3157.jpg[/img]

- Suzuki, Sunbreak Director[/i]


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks, as always for taking the time to check it out!

To the Hunters that’ll be watching along with us at the TGS Capcom Online Program, see you there! 

We’ll be back again soon with another community update, but in the meantime, happy hunting!

See you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: Event Quests have returned in Sunbreak!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Just dropping you a message to let you know that Event Quests have returned and will be going live again on a weekly basis starting today!

For those of you unfamiliar with Event Quests, fear not, we’ve got you covered. Event Quests are optional free Quests that are added to the game on a regular, weekly basis. The base version of Monster Hunter Rise has loads of these already that offer a range of challenges with cool rewards such as stickers and layered gear. There’s even collaboration Event Quests with the likes of Street Fighter, Okami, Sonic the Hedgehog and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/c4d76995bb986498a471c4c61a347eeb0b25d4d6.jpg[/img]

All Event Quests, both historical and new, can be grabbed from either Senri the Mailman in Kamura Village, or the Courier at Elgado Outpost!


[h1]Sunbreak Event Quests[/h1]

As mentioned, starting today Event Quests are back! Every Thursday (or Wednesday if you’re in North America, for example) you’ll be able to take on a new Event Quest to earn useful and, in some cases, unique rewards!

With Event Quests we seek to provide something a little different to existing quests, with new challenges and monster combinations to put your Master Rank hunting skills to the test, like the “Dual Threat” quests that were mentioned in the August Digital Event – so we hope you have a lot of fun with them! 

[b]This Week’s Quest – “A Grand Gesture”[/b]

To get things started we’re starting with “A Grand Gesture”, literally! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/da800bd99250e14fb9d6089c593ef673b8b23b3b.jpg[/img]

In this quest you’ll be tasked with hunting both a Blood Orange Bishaten and an Aknosom in the Shrine Ruins! 

This one’s open too all Hunters MR1 or higher, so as long as you’ve arrived in Elgado you’ll be good to go!

Hunters that complete this quest will get themselves a special gesture too, “It’s Over!”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/4edf529b65085e3798ab2678094c078d4899ea32.jpg[/img]

[b]An Eventful Time Ahead[/b]

That wraps up our quick post on Event Quests! 

This is just the start of Sunbreak’s Master Rank Event Quests, so get ready for some sweet new challenges and even sweeter rewards over the coming weeks…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/5e885020f0d93ae1c186305a2f13b258b3922965.png[/img]

See you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: Title Update 1 Digital Event – New Content Overview!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Today we presented our latest Sunbreak Digital Event, hosted by Monster Hunter Series Producer Ryozo Tsujimoto and Sunbreak Game Director Yoshitake Suzuki, that delved into the exciting new endgame content coming as part of the free Title Update 1!

The best bit? Title Update 1 will be available on Steam from August 10th! That’s right, you’ll be able to dive into all this new content from tomorrow (or right now if you’re reading this after the date)!

For those that didn’t catch the Digital Event live, we thought we’d share an overview of what was discussed, as well as the new update trailer. If you’d like to watch the Digital Event in full, which sits at a little over 15 minutes, we’ll share a link at the end of the post.

Now, let’s get stuck in with the new trailer:  

[previewyoutube=I0h65pK-R3o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Title Update 1 – Content Overview[/b][/h1]

As you can see, there’s lots of new content coming to Sunbreak, from new monsters and gear to the expansion of the endgame with more Anomaly Quests, the new Anomaly Investigation feature and Qurious crafting! 

We’ll be touching on those below to give you an idea of what you can expect, so grab your dango and get comfy…

[b]New Monsters and Locale[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/dc497538e441f5538872c3c770f1e0109632f13d.png[/img]

That’s right, we’ve got four new monsters for you to hunt as part of Title Update 1! 

Many of you will be aware of Lucent Nargacuga and Seething Bazelguese, but they’re also joined by Gold Rathian and Silver Rathalos, who are more than ready to turn up the heat! 

[i]Lucent Nargacuga & the Forlorn Arena[/i]

Lucent Nargacuga is a Rare Species of Nargacuga that was last seen in Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate back in 2013!

This Flying Wyvern has the ability to use its bright white fur to refract moonlight, allowing it to become invisible. Think Chameleos, but much more agile! We suggest keeping a lookout for the red glow of Lucent Nargacuga’s eyes… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/7a26c3758d30a8e9958e3286b584bb9e9e7382e2.jpg[/img]

Oh and watchout for this monster’s vicious poison attacks too!

You’ll be taking on Lucent Nargacuga in its home territory, the Forlorn Arena, a returning locale that’s been carefully recreated to preserve and further enhance the foreboding and mysterious ambience of this area…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TbB8fpGKmgH0juxApO/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]


[i]Seething Bazelguese[/i]

Seething Bazelguese is a Variant of Bazelguese with a twist, its explosive scales are constantly active, making it much more dangerous than its base version.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/847e5a160d6fbcfd0aa0ab9484779dfb70b8daaa.jpg[/img]

Not only that, but it can go into an even more powerful state where it literally seethes with rage where it’ll shower the area with critically volatile scales.

Keep on moving and keep a Wirebug handy, just in case! 


[i]Gold Rathian and Silver Rathalos[/i]

Two more Rare Species have arrived in the form of Gold Rathian and Silver Rathalos! 

They can go into a powerful Incandescent state where they’ll attack with even more ferocity, raining blue fire down on all that dare challenge them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/0ca666e4d0ce2de607967b2ac06c12dbe81d8800.jpg[/img]

The team have also given them both some new moves for Sunbreak, so if you thought you knew them from hunting them in Iceborne, a whole new challenge awaits you!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/132dab2236eba3fa8603778c546bad3754c3ddc9.jpg[/img]


[b]New Monsters, New Gear![/b]

That’s right, all these new monster additions bring with them new armour and weapons for you to craft and wield in the hunt! All of the armour sets that you can forge from materials of the monsters added in Title Update 1 also come with new skills as well, so we hope you have fun trying them out!

Get a closer look at a couple of the sets below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/d41caa5c195f7bebdf2e59691ee9193e0f24e59d.jpg[/img]
Embrace the moonlight with Lucent Nargacuga’s gear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/911858ee3fd9e19836ea0e7cc844f23a16b7ac45.jpg[/img]
Become truly incandescent with Golden Rathian’s gear!


[b]Expanded Anomaly Quests[/b]

Starting with Title Update 1, the afflicted monster gameplay endgame is greatly expanding! 

Hunters will be able to take on A5⭐ Anomaly Quests, bringing with them new afflicted monsters to face: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/2030c2dc46a24593436e328f193d417ed40b91b5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/26b09b5621df4bfc50a6a42a44f09bc81139cece.jpg[/img]

A5⭐ monsters are unlocked through a new mechanic called Anomaly Investigations. That’s right, Investigations are back! Let’s delve into the details of how this quest system works in Sunbreak…


[b]Anomaly Investigations[/b] 

The biggest new addition to Title Update 1 are Anomaly Investigations. Whilst there are some similarities between Investigations in Iceborne, there’s some exciting changes that we’ll go through now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/dcde0d399c234b41af1aea30d22cee28ca338f15.jpg[/img]

All Anomaly Investigations have a set level. As the levels increase, the monsters will become gradually stronger and the rewards you can earn will change! 

The quest conditions, such as the target monster, locale and maximum player count are all decided at random too!

Successfully completing these investigations will open new upgrade options for your weapons and armour, so these quests are well worth exploring!

About those weapon and armour upgrades, it’s time to introduce… 


[b]Qurious Crafting – Weapons & Armour Upgrades[/b]

The materials you earn from the new Anomaly Investigations can be used to add newly introduced upgrades to your equipment, yep that includes both weapons and armour!

[i]Weapons[/i]

Let’s take a look at weapon’s first:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/a8697467ba98bd0fcf3a7601285fa24a84acb629.jpg[/img]

With Qurious Weapon crafting you can select the kinds of upgrades you want to best suit your preferred playstyle!

Using Malzeno’s Greatsword as an example, you’ll be able to upgrade your preferred stats:
[list]
[*]Attack Power
[*]Affinity
[*]Elemental Power
[*]Sharpness 
[*]Rampage Deco Slots
[/list]
There is a limit though, so choose carefully! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/777feaeaa08d3dbe28a6b43d1c3ddd07f42dca67.jpg[/img]

If you’d like to focus on one or two upgrades in particular, you can choose to further increase their level and effectiveness at the cost of more slots being used up.

This opens up a lot of new options for your weapons, we can’t wait to see what you come up with! 


[i]Armour[/i]

As mentioned, you’ll also be able to further upgrade your favourite armour sets and pieces! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/7ff513913ddfee7bacb29f1c38b6ce8b2fb7a656.jpg[/img]

Armour can be upgraded with random improvements including defence, resistance and even skill points! If you don’t like a proposed upgrade, you can choose to ignore it if you want, so you still have control on what gets applied! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/00983290e3e308a7257f2e68055ee6acf6318d8c.jpg[/img]


[b]Bahari’s Open for Business and Beyond[/b]

Bahari the Scientist has opened his Anomaly Research Lab!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/319ebc136ab67ee33e4d68a2171146576e1d664c.jpg[/img]

The Anomaly Research Lab allows you to exchange the items you’ve gained from Anomaly Investigations for items that are useful in Qurious Crafting, so it’ll be well worth your time paying Bahari a visit!

We’re pleased to share that the quest ranks, as well as the monsters that appear for Anomaly Quests, as well as the level cap for Anomaly Investigations will continue to expand and grow with each new Title Update, so get ready Hunters! 


[b]Event Quests Return![/b]

You read that correctly, Event Quests return from August 18th! This means new Event Quests every week, with a variety of fun conditions and challenges for you to enjoy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/860743661a53442b15f767a906171c4d6fb02f36.jpg[/img]
No monkeying around here! 

As part of Sunbreak’s Event Quests we’ll be introducing extra challenging quests called “Dual Threats”. In Dual Threat quests you’ll have to hunt two monsters at the same time, such as Gold Rathian and Silver Rathalos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/0169652c33bbd5a01954fe7a2c7fa7bfcab3be5b.jpg[/img]
Can you take down the ultimate power couple?  

[i]Event Quest Rewards[/i]

Of course, with new Event Quests comes sweet new rewards for you to earn!

We’ve grabbed an example of just one of the many upcoming rewards below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/5e885020f0d93ae1c186305a2f13b258b3922965.png[/img]
Well, some do say that fashion game is the true endgame! 


[h1]Join The Hunt[/h1]

If you liked what you say in today’s post and are yet to start your Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak adventure, you can currently pick up the base version of Monster Hunter Rise at a 49% discount until August 16th! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1446780/MONSTER_HUNTER_RISE/

Upon completing the 7* Gathering Hub Quest “Serpent Goddess of Thunder” you’ll be ready to upgrade to the Sunbreak massive expansion content, including what we detailed today!


[h1]Quest Complete – Enjoy Title Update 1![/h1]

That wraps up today’s Digital Event and Title Update 1 Recap post!

If you liked what you saw, or are keen to learn even more about Title Update 1, it’s definitely worth watching the Digital Event in full where Ryozo Tsujimoto and Sunbreak Game Director Yoshitake Suzuki take you through the finer details with new gameplay footage.

Check it out here:
[previewyoutube=BctIUWYRvnE;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks everyone, we hope you have a fantastic time with Title Update 1!

See you in the hunt. 

- Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: Kamura Hunter's Hub #13 – Sunbreak Launch and looking ahead to Title Update 1!
notes.content:

All of us from the dev team are deeply thankful. I'm here to present an illustration to commemorate the occasion, and to let everyone know that we're working hard on future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/e3bd87df0f1a570fbed42fd83006234f28e6ab3d.jpg[/img]

We’ll be sharing more information on Title Update 1, including when you’ll be able to play it, on the lead up to its launch. Watch this space Hunters!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/tthbL6vdHDy751YkS8/giphy.gif[/img]

Elgado Outpost awaits you now that Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak has launched!

Ready Hunters? Prepare to venture into a lush locale, the Jungle, as your quest to save the Kingdom brings you face to face with dangerous new monsters…

[previewyoutube=AzplEyeMdzc;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Welcome to the Jungle![/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/MSBzc0wOnoOZnC7NxZ/giphy.gif[/img]

The Jungle, a paradise for the wide range of monsters and plant life that inhabit it. Prepare to explore and hunt your way through lush, tree-laden greenery, sweeping beaches that lead to relaxing waterside areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/5b27119f29a1fe3980353f8f16d2e4c6ac3a92e3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/c52d976805cc1a54361ce3ce405e21ea6bcc1f89.jpg[/img]

As you delve deeper into the Jungle and its secrets, you’ll find yourself in expansive subterranean caverns and what lurks within them…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/ede41974a37481d961f6956a47c639c6d1bf9c44.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/982c8b5dd7abfb30861e372defdb9bd288049626.jpg[/img]

If you’re keen to explore the Jungle ahead of launch, make sure to check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880360/Monster_Hunter_Rise_Sunbreak/]Sunbreak demo[/url] that’s available to play for free right now!


[h1]New Monsters![/h1]

Along with a new locale, 5 new monsters were also revealed!

[b]Espinas[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/43jY53upcR3QLEGdEG/giphy.gif[/img]

This will be the first time many of you will go face to face with this returning monster from Monster Hunter Frontier!

Espinas is a flying wyvern known for the red spikes that cover their tough green hide, which double up as both an offensive and defensive tool.

Due to their stalwart defence they’re using found relaxing in their territory, however upon sensing danger they expand their blood vessels, turning their hide and wing membranes a bright red before running riot with full brutality.

Be warned! Do your best to avoid being hit by Espinas’s venomous fireballs, yes, you read that correctly.


[b]Gore Magala[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/pkHfz4H2ejqdrN97xo/giphy.gif[/img]

The Black Eclipse wyvern, Gore Magala, returns in Sunbreak!

It may lack visual receptors but makes up for it with heightened senses that are attuned to the scales it scatters from its wings. Once a lifeform is detected Gore Magala will lash out without remorse.

At the peak of their senses, purple feelers will extend from their head, their wings will unfurl and they’ll become frenzied, unleashing devastating attacks that can rupture the very ground.

Will you overcome the frenzy?


[b]Daiymo Hermitaur[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/zHVINK6bv3X43i3rib/giphy.gif[/img]

Can you overcome the massive claws of Daiymo Hermitaur? Equally powerful when used for attacking or defensive purposes, you’ll need to fight strategically to find a safe opening against this large Carapaceon! 

Be wary of the wyvern skulls they wear as shells on their backs too. These not only provide a high level of protection for Daiymo Hermitaurs, but can also be used for attacking their prey…


[b]Pyre Rakna-Kadaki[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kzgnkXlLwxUOYdQ8Vq/giphy.gif[/img]

A subspecies of Rakna-Kadaki, Pyre Rakna-Kataki is an explosive fight, blasting Hunters with the volatile material that fills their bodies. Covered in a explosion-resistant webbing, they can strike together their forelimbs like flints to induce explosions – so watch out for surprise area of effect attacks!

They also have an advanced chain of command over their offspring, allowing them to expand the reach of their explosions with ease.


[b]Lucent Nargacuga[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/tthbL6vdHDy751YkS8/giphy.gif[/img]

We bet you didn’t see this one coming!

Lucent Nargacuga will leap into Sunbreak as part of Title Update 1 after launch. Elgado Outpost’s researchers are still investigating this rare species of Flying Wyvern, but initial findings suggest that this monster is incredibly effective at camouflaging itself…


That wraps up our quick overview of the latest Sunbreak monsters to be revealed! There’s even more to discover as part of the trailer, but we’ll let you discover those!


[h1]The Hunt Continues June 30th![/h1]

Elgado Outpost awaits you when Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak launches on June 30th! 

Prepare to take on the Three Lords and everything this mysteriously land has to offer by pre-purchasing here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880360/Monster_Hunter_Rise_Sunbreak/

Hunters who pre-purchase will also receive:  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/249706b333b95f4b68005601d0da3c618d7d96e8.jpg[/img]

[b]Bonus Add-on Content[/b]
[list]
[*]"Loyal Dog Costume" Palamute layered armour set
[*]"Striped Cat Costume" Palico layered armour set
[/list]
Note: Layered armour is a "skin" which changes the appearance of the character without affecting their stats and abilities.


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks as always for taking the time to check it out!

We’re so close to launch now, with less than a week to go! The team are so excited for you to discover a new land full of monsters as you arrive at Elgado Outpost from the 30th. 

Thank you all so much for your support so far, we look forward to hearing about your new adventures in Sunbreak soon.

Oh, and one last thing before we go, if you can’t wait until the 30th, check out the free Sunbreak demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880360/Monster_Hunter_Rise_Sunbreak/]HERE[/url], where you’ll be able to try out the new Switch Skill Swap and Swap Evade mechanics, as well as challenging new monsters Astalos and Malzeno!

We’ll see you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team

notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #11 – Sunbreak: New Weapon Actions!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to Kamura Hunter’s Hub #11!

Since our last post, we’ve been revealing brand new weapon actions coming to Sunbreak over on the Monster Hunter social channels. We’d seen some of you chatting about it and discussing the reveals here in General Discussions, so we thought hey, now all 14 weapons have had their reveals lets share all that goodness for our Steam Hunters! 

In today’s post we’ll be detailing four of the weapons and linking to the other ten so you can see them all in action! After the weapons we’ll also be showing you how Sunbreak is building upon Rise’s Dango mechanics to give you even more choice when going into a hunt…


[h1][b]New Silkbind Attacks and Switch Skills[/b][/h1]

As previously mentioned in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3204885459608209914]Kamura Hunter’s Hub #10[/url], you’ll be able to unlock new Switch Skills and Silkbind Attacks for all 14 weapons and utilise them using the new “Switch Skill Swap” mechanic. 

As for the new skills themselves, let’s take a look at what you’ll be using in the hunt!

[b]Switch Axe[/b]

Switch up your style with new Switch Axe moves, including a powerful new counter-attack!

[previewyoutube=bmDAjh1U0Lo;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Elemental Burst Counter[/i]

Unleash a decisive counter-attack just as a monster strikes to perform a Power Finisher, immediately energising your Switch Axe into an Amped State!

[i]Axe: 2-Staged Morph Slash Combo[/i]

An impressive combo that follows your Axe: Wild Swing.
During this combo, the power of Sword Mode attacks increase and Axe Mode attacks fill the Switch Gauge faster.


[b]Great Sword[/b]

Become an unrelenting force with new Great Sword silkbind combos!

[previewyoutube=imxWwkkigSE;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Strongarm Stance[/i]

Reinforce both your arms and weapon with Ironsilk to temporarily fend off attacks.
If used while charging, you can quickly parry an attack and then unleash a fierce onslaught afterwards.

[i]Surge Slash Combo[/i]

An offensive style that combines speed with the weight of the Great Sword to unleash a stream of powerful strikes in quick succession.


[b]Bow[/b]

Level up your archery game with versatile new Silkbind abilities for the Bow!

[previewyoutube=BSIAriabitg;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Butcher's Bind[/i]

Fires an arrow loaded with Ironsilk.

If the follow-up arrow lands in the same spot as the first, Ironsilk winds around both arrows, inflicting severing damage.

If the second arrow is off target, the lodged arrow disappears.

[i]Stake Thrust[/i]

An attack that thrusts an explosive stake into your target.

The stake reacts to follow-up attacks, dealing extra damage to the target. The amount of extra damage dealt is determined by type of arrow loosed!


[b]Hunting Horn[/b]

DOOT DOOT! The beatdown just don't stop with groovy new Hunting Horn moves!

[previewyoutube=3-DA6jBrsBg;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Silkbind Shockwave[/i]

A Silkbind attack that wraps the Hunting Horn in Ironsilk. For a short time, any attack causes the silk to vibrate, creating a time-delayed shockwave that triggers additional hits. These additional hits do major stun, exhaust, and part damage. DOOT!

[i]Swing Combo[/i]

A two-hit attack that can be delivered from either the left or right. This allows you to quickly shift directions, making it useful for repositioning in true Hunting Horn style.


[b]Even more weapons![/b]

Not spotted your favourite weapons yet? Fear not, we’ve got links to their bespoke videos for you right here:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=frHRZfTcHGs&t=1s]Long Sword[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K4Sddovs5rk]Sword & Shield[/url]

[h1]Introducing Hopping Skewers[/h1]

It’s time to level up your Dango, Sunbreak style!

In addition to the regular skewers you’re familiar with, you’ll also have access to new “Hopping Skewers”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/dc7aefdc9903fe1b370eb77ab1432f37d455a52e.jpg[/img]

Hopping Skewers are an optional, alternative method of eating before a hunt that enhances two Dango skills at the cost of the third one being weaker. Watch those activation chances too, it might be worth using a Dango Ticket to help secure some powerful buffs!

notes.title: Kamura Hunter’s Hub #10 – Sunbreak Digital Event Recap!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to Kamura Hunter’s Hub #10!

We’ve got an info packed post this week as we dive into the new monsters, hunting actions and more that have just been revealed during the Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak – May Digital Event!

We’d also like to extend a huge WELCOME to all the new Hunters that have joined us as part of the recent discount, welcome to Kamura!! If you’re looking for some pointers to help you settle in and thrive in Kamura, we’ve got some helpful posts you can check out below:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129434881277902033][b]Introducing Wirebugs & Mobility Usage[/b][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129435606049210916][b]Wirebug Usage – Aerial Usage[/b][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129437417942234611][b]Offensive Wirebug Usage – Silkbind Attacks[/b][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1446780/announcements/detail/3129438777523823846][b]Getting Started: Village Tips[/b][/url]

Make sure to pay Senri the Mailman a visit too, he’ll have some useful items, armour and weaponry to help you on your early hunts!

Now, we’ve got a Digital Event to recap…


[h1][b]May Digital Event – New Monsters, Hunting Actions and More![/b][/h1]

On May 10th we held our latest Digital Event for Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak, revealing even more fearsome threats that you’ll have to overcome in Elgado! But fear not, you won’t be facing them alone thanks to new hunting techniques and allies that will aid you in your journey…

[previewyoutube=kyFwal-l20A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Seregios[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/2428fc48d8e76ee3f04b6fc8710664530c67745e.jpg[/img]

Steel yourselves for a dance of a thousand blades with Seregios. This Flying Wyvern can detach and send razor-sharp scales flying in the direction of its prey... afflicting them with the Bleeding status ailment for a painful death of a thousand cuts. 

Those afflicted with the Bleeding status would be wise to watch their movement and seek a hasty recovery…


[b]Aurora Somnacanth[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/a54857ab7979ee732e22a2ed94b04c9411ae4b41.jpg[/img]

Bundle up and stay frosty when facing Aurora Somnacanth, a subspecies that has evolved to conjure up chilling breaths and bend ice to its will. 


[b]Magma Almudron[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/47719ee9c73e0007f0722daf91153a7c4ec39d48.jpg[/img]

Magma Almudron turns up the heat as it trades its signature mud manipulation tricks for searing hot molten lava. Keep your wits about you and watch your surroundings, what may seem safe footing at first can quickly change.


[b]Malzeno's Bloodblight[/b]

The Guild’s continued research on this mysterious Elder Dragon has gained new insight! It appears some of its power is derived from a malicious Bloodblight that it can inflict on its enemies. Hunters, we advise extreme caution when taking on Malzeno, lest it bleed you dry…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/3ae3c06d1c343755d9678b0fbd2fa3d9ababa740.jpg[/img]


[h1]More Hunting Actions[/h1]

With new monsters and subspecies looming on the horizon and reports showing that returning monsters are displaying new and varied sets of attacks and tricks, you’ll need to be ready for every possible situation to even the odds!

In Sunbreak you’ll be able to unlock new Switch Skills and Silkbind Attacks for all 14 weapons at your disposal. To make sure you’re ready for every possible situation a new technique has been honed, Switch Skill Swap!

[b]Switch Skill Swap[/b]

In Sunbreak, you’ll be able to assign individual Switch Skills to two groups: Red Swap Scroll and Blue Swap Scroll. This will allow you employ a wider variety of attacks and abilities during your hunts. This will be very handy when hunting multiple monsters in one quest, or if you want to try out a new Switch Skill without giving up an old favourite in the same slot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/e014f8e20378b674b85fe2d90a2de98e79a67200.jpg[/img]

For example, when playing Sword & Shield, you would normally have to choose between “Windmill” and “Metsu Shoryugeki”. Now you’ll able to assign “Windmill” to one of the Swap Scrolls and use for safely dispatching a pack of Boggi, then quickly swap to “Metsu Shoryugeki” to counter-attack one of Garangolm’s jump attacks.

Speaking of weapon combat, we’ll be showing off some examples and new tricks you can pull off with each of the 14 weapon types starting next week on May 16th. So make sure you’re following the [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]@MonsterHunter[/url] social channels and subscribed to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVS0xBpOtXBAl12rdG67-OQ]Monster Hunter YouTube channel[/url] to be among the first to see what’s coming up.


[h1]More Features – Follower Quests![/h1]

In your journey through Sunbreak, you’re not alone!

In addition to the standard selection of single and multiplayer quests you’re familiar with, we’re also introducing Follower Quests! This curated selection of special quests are single-player only and allow you to team up with some familiar faces from both Kamura and Elgado Outpost to take on fearsome monsters together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/229c133fa84211c5fe51616aa04c30b48a861a43.jpg[/img]

We’ve already had Hinoa and Minoto join us briefly during Rampage Quests, and we’ve been seeing Dame Fiorayne show off her Sword & Shield skills throughout various teasers... but with Follower Quests, you’ll be able to team-up with them throughout an entire hunt! Other characters will be able to join you as well, but we’re keeping the final list under wraps for now.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0N4lq9F1Dgrj30yMqn/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]Even More Content[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/18e8f89fcc2b6feaea33c624079ef89f53a5e693.jpg[/img]

[b]Navirou[/b]

Looks like we’re not done talking about guest characters, huh? Everyone’s favourite donut-loving Felyne and self-proclaimed hero, Navirou, is sneaking his way into Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak, in the form of a special layered armour costume decked out with fun custom animations and expressions! 

To unlock this, you’ll just need to own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1277400/Monster_Hunter_Stories_2_Wings_of_Ruin/]Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin[/url] on Steam!

[b]Title updates & More News[/b]

We’re also pleased to confirm that Sunbreak will receive several free title updates post-launch. We’ll have more news to share on the free updates, as well as even more exciting Sunbreak news around June – so watch this space!


[h1]The Hunt Continues June 30th![/h1]

Elgado Outpost awaits you when Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak launches on June 30th! 

Prepare to take on the Three Lords and everything this mysteriously land has to offer by pre-purchasing here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880360/Monster_Hunter_Rise_Sunbreak/

Hunters who pre-purchase will also receive:  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286238/249706b333b95f4b68005601d0da3c618d7d96e8.jpg[/img]

[b]Bonus Add-on Content[/b]

[*]"Loyal Dog Costume" Palamute layered armour set
[*]"Striped Cat Costume" Palico layered armour set
[/list]
Note: Layered armour is a "skin" which changes the appearance of the character without affecting their stats and abilities.


[h1]Quest Complete – We’ll see you next time![/h1]

That wraps up this week’s community post! Thanks for taking the time to check it out.

We hope you enjoyed all the new details and reveals from the May Digital Event! What was your favourite reveal? Which new monster are you most excited to face? Let us know in the comments!! 

If you’d like to watch all 16 minutes of the May Digital Event you can do so [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0y-PV7puX-U]HERE[/url]. 

Also, one more thing - Starting the week of May 16th we’ll be sharing brand new Silkbind Weapon Skill videos on our Twitter account, so don’t miss out and drop us a follow on the official [url=https://twitter.com/monsterhunter]Monster Hunter[/url] account.

We’ll see you in the hunt!

- The Monster Hunter Community Team
